semantics.clock: All sequential logic on positive edge, as specified
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset begins searching; overrides all states
semantics.search: Detect contiguous 1101 with overlapping prefixes; next four edges capture delay MSB first
semantics.start: After fourth delay bit edge, counting asserted with count equal to captured delay
semantics.finish: After exactly (delay+1)*1000 counting periods, counting deasserts and done asserts
semantics.ack: In done state, ack sampled high returns to empty search on that edge; data on that edge ignored
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up state; verification applies synchronous reset before requiring outputs

numeric.interval: Each remaining count value is presented for 1000 full clock periods

verification.oracle: Independent serial sliding-window detector and total elapsed-cycle model from original problem
verification.sampling: Drive at negative edge; compare after positive-edge NBA updates
verification.cases: All 16 delays, overlapping patterns, ignored data, held done, ack, reset during search/capture/count/done
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout and explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities: Power-up values are unspecified; no checks before first synchronous reset.
Count outside counting is explicitly don't-care and is not checked.
Pattern overlap is not separately described; contiguous occurrence detection includes overlapping prefixes.
